entries.label: Compact V5 nested rows with resolved theme
entries.head: 866f4358b196ea156813030cea4ceb9d41e430e1

verdicts.note: Live V5 default preview measures 28px child rows with 2px vertical padding; parent remains 32px. Browser tests cover the resolved default theme, 44px touch targets, V4 parity, authored heights/padding, multiline growth, and 12 disclosure-scroll cases. Local sample injection needs no network request; SDK streaming is outside this spacing proof.
